criteria.criterion: Test (cargo test): two introspections with the same cause on different jobs queue exactly one urgent root-cause request citing both introspection ids via the shared steward request builder; a third introspection with that cause does not queue another while that request is open or landed.
criteria.evidence: Ran hestia::tests::two_introspections_of_one_cause_in_different_jobs_queue_one_urgent_request_and_a_third_queues_none, which passed. The first introspection queues nothing. The second, on another job, queues exactly one request. That request starts with 'Priority: urgent', its job priority() is Urgent, it contains both introspection ids, and the builder's own parse (request_text_acceptance) accepts it. A third introspection while the request is open queues nothing, so request_jobs stays at 1 and the count is 3. A fourth after an outcome marks the request landed also queues nothing. root_cause_request builds the text with crate::steward::StewardRequest::new.

criteria.criterion: Test (cargo test): a single-job repeat, or causes already cited by an open or landed request, queue nothing.
criteria.evidence: a_single_job_repeat_or_a_cited_cause_queues_nothing passed. Two introspections of the same job give no repeated cause and no request. A hand-queued request that cites one introspection id stops the review from queuing a second request, and repeated_causes names that request. Failed introspections and ones with no job are not counted. The landed case is covered in the criterion-1 test.

criteria.criterion: Test (cargo test): athena status output lists each open repeated cause with its count and the request addressing it.
criteria.evidence: athena_status_lists_each_open_repeated_cause_with_its_count_and_its_request passed. It calls athena.status() and checks that repeated_causes is [(3,3,Some(queued)), (2,2,None)]. The cause whose request landed is left out, the request state reads 'queued', and a next-step line appears for the cause with no request. The display test repeated_causes_are_listed_with_their_counts_and_the_request_that_addresses_them in athena-cli passed and checks the rendered text: 'repeated    2 time(s) in 2 jobs', 'request <job> (queued)', 'no request yet', and the introspection ids.

criteria.criterion: Test (cargo test): the scope guard counts a retry (previous_job) and a re-ask of the same request text as one line of work and pauses at its threshold, not per job id.
criteria.evidence: scope_guard::watcher_tests::a_retry_and_a_re_ask_of_the_same_request_are_one_line_that_pauses_at_its_threshold passed. It runs request a, then a 'try again on a' retry, then a re-ask c with the same words. group_lines gives [[0,1,2]]. The line pauses with attempts=3, rejections=3 and signals T1, T4. The re-ask has no mark of its own, and a fourth ask is refused as paused. Without the new same_text_as link, c would be its own line and the pause would not fire, so the test depends on the change. The companion test asking_the_words_of_a_landed_request_again_starts_a_new_line also passed. The retry link is 'try again on <job>', not the athena.candidate/2 previous_job field. chain.rs confirms that field is the latest job landed in the base's history, shared by unrelated jobs. The code and the design doc both state this choice and the reason.

findings.summary: The root-cause request names only a broad Files line.

summary: The change passes: all six acceptance criteria are met and nothing found is serious. Hestia now has an error review, enforced in code. Each time an introspection is recorded, `introspect` runs `Athena::error_review`. It groups introspections by cause: the class in the class registry, else Jev's class answer, else the cause text with case and punctuation ignored. When a cause shows up in two or more distinct jobs and no open or landed request cites any of its introspections, it queues one urgent root-cause request through `StewardRequest`, citing those introspection ids. `athena status` lists the open repeated causes, each with its count, its number of jobs and the request that addresses it, in both the data and the printed text. The scope guard now also joins a re-ask with the same words into the line of the earlier request, if that line was not accepted, so a retry and a re-ask count as one line and the line pauses at its existing threshold. For the retry link it uses "try again on <job>", not the `athena.candidate/2` `previous_job` field. I checked chain.rs: that field names the latest job landed in the base's history, which unrelated jobs share, so following it would merge their counts. The code and the design doc both state this choice. I ran the new hestia, scope_guard and display tests and all passed; fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded checks. Two small findings: `crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs` is outside the expected deliverables list (minor; it is the change that prints the status lines), and every root-cause request names only `crates/` as its files (nit).
